import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from quantum_probe.sweep_v1 import run_sweep

def main():
    rid, out_path, summary = run_sweep(lineage="kairos", agent="Kairos I")
    print("SWEEP_OK", rid, out_path, json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
